Gita once orchestrated a critical infrastructure shift during EcoCart’s holiday sale surge. When traffic spiked 300% overnight, she rerouted workloads across GCP and AWS using Kubernetes, preventing downtime. Her calm under pressure and deep understanding of distributed systems ensured seamless scaling, a moment that solidified her reputation as a reliable problem-solver.  

Gita is a Staff Platform Engineer at EcoCart, leading CI/CD pipeline design and Kubernetes architecture. She owns cross-team infrastructure projects, balancing technical rigor with mentorship. Her work ethic is unshakable—she arrives early, stays late, and treats systems as living entities requiring constant care.  

Her strength lies in translating abstract system needs into concrete, scalable solutions. She pioneered network automation tools that cut deployment friction by 40%, and her GCP/AWS hybrid strategy reduced redundant workflows. Beyond code, she fosters collaboration, guiding junior engineers through complex Terraform configurations. Her decisions prioritize resilience and efficiency, whether refactoring monolithic services or designing multi-cluster Kubernetes setups.  

Gita’s technical depth and leadership make her indispensable. She doesn’t just solve problems—she redefines how teams approach infrastructure. I’m confident she’ll thrive in any role demanding both precision and vision.
